## Agentic Access (MCP)
www.froste.eu is a static site, so the MCP server is hosted on Supabase. Connect to the endpoint below, not to the domain.

MCP endpoint: `https://jcsjqnjvnqqghiaawhcl.supabase.co/functions/v1/mcp-server` (streamable HTTP)
Manifest: https://www.froste.eu/mcp.json

Open without a key:
- `get_profile` — who Magnus is: positioning, audience, offering, core themes, availability, links. Start here.
- `get_resume` — the full profile as markdown: name, title, availability, roles, assignments, projects
- `kb_list` / `kb_get` — the public knowledge base documents one by one
- `list_projects` — browse Magnus's GitHub projects
- `get_project` — full enriched data for one project (problem, why-it-matters, README, images)
- `search_projects` — full-text search across all projects
- `analyze_job_fit` — score a role or assignment against the CV: 0–100, skill match, strengths, gaps, recommendation
- `generate_tailored_cv` — match analysis, tailored CV and cover letter in markdown
- `contact_magnus` — send Magnus a message with name and email; he replies personally
AI tools and contact are rate limited per hour for anonymous callers.

With a Bearer MCP key (the site owner's operator agents): the CMS itself. Tools appear according to the key's scopes —
`read` (site_overview, inbox, conversations, analytics, review queue, settings, private knowledge), `content` (blog drafts, pages and blocks, projects, newsletter drafts, knowledge base writes), `review` (approve Autopilot work, publish posts, send newsletters) and `settings` (site settings, modules, navigation, automations). Start with `site_overview`.
Resources: `project://<repo-name>` per synced GitHub repo
